raj_p: Heads up — after merge of PR #4521 we're seeing a perf regression on A10 and L4. CI job a10-ps1 p95 tokens jumped ~3x about 2h after deploy.
maria_s: Which part of the heuristic changed? fallback or scoring weights?
alex_k: The scoring weights were adjusted to prefer f16-tuned kernels. On H100 that helps, but on A10/L4 the selected kernel forces a synchronous memcpy pattern.
ting_w: Reproduced on an A10 replica: short seq (<128) throughput down ~40%. KV cache hit-rate stable but token latency spikes.
raj_p: CI snippet:
```
perf-run --model star-7b --hw a10 --batch 8 --seq 64
p95 95ms -> 320ms
flamegraph: big blocks in 'kv-cache-serialize' + 'gpu-memcpy-sync'
```
ci-bot: perf-regression-detect: job a10-ps1 failed threshold (p95 increase 2.9x) — alert fired
maria_s: OK let's bisect: range 4490..4521 on canary A10. Check kernel-selection table changes around 4508. Try reverting only the heuristic delta first.
alex_k: Bisect narrows to commit 3f9b2a7 (4508). That commit tweaks kernel scoring and adds an early-exit in select_kernel() when score diff < 0.05.
raj_p: Early-exit on A10 picks attn_opt_v2 which uses a sharded-async memcpy path that ends up synchronizing. H100 selects attn_opt_v3 so unaffected.
ting_w: Profiler timeline shows cudaMemcpyAsync -> cudaDeviceSynchronize spikes at token boundaries (12-16) causing KV ops to serialize.
maria_s: KV miss-rate? or just added serialization overhead?
alex_k: Miss-rate ~4% unchanged, but avg KV fetch latency 0.9ms -> 6.3ms. That points to extra memcpy syncs.
raj_p: Mitigation: revert commit 3f9b2a7 on canaries and add a HW-aware override to prefer attn_opt_v3 on A10/L4 until we fix the memcpy path. Also add unit tests for small-batch short-seq on A10.
ting_w: I pushed revert PR #4536 to staging; deploy-bot applied it to a10-canary1. Early metrics look good: p95 back to ~110ms.
deploy-bot: Rollout: PR 4536 deployed to canary (a10-canary1) at 2025-02-24T14:12:33Z ✅
ci-bot: Requeued perf job; passes threshold on canary now.
maria_s: Root cause looks like kernel implementation detail. We should add a micro-benchmark that streams KV cache pages across seq boundaries to catch memcpy-sync regressions. Run full kernel matrix on L4 lab devices.
alex_k: I'll instrument select_kernel to log chosen kernel + score rationale for the first 100k requests in staging to gather data.
raj_p: Action items:
- alex_k: keep revert and logs until proper fix (PR 4540).
- ting_w: run microbenchmarks on L4 + A10, collect timelines and flamegraphs.
- maria_s: add CI regression tests that run short-seq workload on A10 emulation and fail PRs increasing p95 >1.5x.
- ops: hold prod rollout until verified on dedicated A10 clusters.
maria_s: Also consider changing kernel-selection rules: prefer memcpy-free kernels when seq<128 and KV cache enabled.
raj_p: Marking this thread rollout-blocker until A10/L4 validated. Filing incident INF-1029 and linking PRs.
ci-bot: Incident INF-1029 created: perf regression – kernel-selection -> A10/L4 p95 spike
ting_w: Dropping L4 runs into the ticket. Ping me if you need a device.
alex_k: Revert remains in staging. I'll work on avoiding syncs inside attn_opt_v2 and reopen when ready.
raj_p: Thanks all. Post profiler snippets here once uploaded. :eyes:
alex_k: Uploaded flamegraphs to /shared/perf/1749152233/ — problematic trace snippet:
```
0.00s  attn_opt_v2 - cudaMemcpyAsync -> cudaDeviceSynchronize (20ms)
0.02s  kv-cache-serialize (8ms)
0.03s  next-token emit
```
maria_s: Good catch. This is a kernel implementation issue. Patch kernel or update heuristic.
raj_p: Keep updates in-thread. End of thread.
